wiki.title: Eric Swalwell
wiki.extract: Eric Michael Swalwell (; born November 16, 1980) is an American former politician who served as a U.S. representative from California from 2013 to 2026. A member of the Democratic Party, Swalwell previously served on the city council for Dublin, California from 2010 to 2013.
